info.title: Dársena local demo API
info.description: Local demonstration and explicitly configured experimental isolated services. Experimental routes require owner authentication. Not a production API.

200.description: The demo and its configured worker are available
Current demo capabilities and bounded dependency availability

409.description: A deployment is already active or the demo limit is reached

get.description: SSE named snapshot events containing a complete Operation JSON. Event ID is the revision. Every connection receives current state, regardless of Last-Event-ID; terminal snapshots close the stream. Clients must close on terminal state and resync via GET after reconnect. Heartbeats are comments. No durable replay.

post.description: Experimental local worker: simulations only. Requires serve --worker-socket. Independent of in-memory application demo.

get.description: List up to 100 latest persistent simulated worker jobs.
Read a persistent simulated worker job.
Experimental; requires a worker with encrypted configuration enabled. Secrets are never returned.
Value-free history, newest first. An existing application without configuration returns an empty list. Old revisions may retain secrets in the vault, but they are never returned.
Persistent definitions with project, configuration and (experimental) service summary; no deployment is performed.

post.description: Creates a definition. Domain errors: 409 domain_taken (never reassigned or suffixed), 400 domain_reserved, 400 invalid_domain.

patch.description: Edits image, port, access, shared network and domain with a version precondition. The image is locked (409 image_locked) once any runtime intention exists; access, shared network, domain and, unless the application is isolated, the port are locked likewise (409 access_locked). 409 runtime_state_unknown if that cannot be determined. Domain errors: 409 domain_taken, 400 domain_reserved, 400 invalid_domain.

delete.description: Deletes the definition and purges its encrypted configuration. 409 application_has_service, runtime_busy or runtime_state_unknown block it.

post.summary: Create the service once; network access follows the application's access setting

revision.description: Configuration revision the client saw; 0 means no saved configuration, and an empty first revision is saved before dispatching.

400.description: Invalid request; image_incompatible, invalid_image or invalid_domain are rejected before anything is persisted

409.description: Conflict. revision_conflict_before_dispatch, image_missing and network_conflict are rejected before anything is persisted; other conflicts do not guarantee absence of an existing operation.

503.description: Worker unavailable; runtime_unavailable if image availability or networks could not be checked, network_unavailable if the daemon has no address space for a new network (nothing persisted in either case)

post.summary: Inspect an existing service without resending creation
Stop an isolated service once; reconcile uncertain results before any further action
Remove an isolated service once; reconcile uncertain results before any further action

delete.description: Never deletes applications; they become unassigned.

post.description: Moves applications to a project (or unassigns with a null project_id), all or nothing. Returns those actually reassigned.

post.summary: Restore a variable from a retained revision
post.description: Saves the value and secret flag of one variable from a retained revision as a new revision. Returns the value-free current snapshot. Errors: configuration_conflict (409, stale revision), revision_not_retained (409), variable_not_in_revision (409), invalid_configuration (400).

get.summary: Normalize an image reference; in experimental mode also resolve a public tag and report availability in the runtime daemon

400.description: invalid_image, or image_digest_required without the experimental runtime

404.description: image_not_found: tag not found in a public registry

post.summary: Explicitly download a pinned public image into the runtime daemon, without registry credentials (experimental only; one at a time; status through GET /worker/image)

403.description: Origin or token rejected; always in demo mode

get.summary: Advisory check of a domain; the unique index decides when an application is saved

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Application whose own domain is not reported as taken.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Worker codes include: invalid_configuration, configuration_conflict, configuration_unavailable, revision_not_retained, variable_not_in_revision, project_name_taken, project_not_found, project_limit, invalid_project, application_not_found, invalid_application, update_conflict, image_locked, application_has_service, runtime_busy, runtime_state_unknown, invalid_image, image_digest_required, image_not_found, registry_unavailable, pull_busy, image_missing, image_incompatible, runtime_unavailable, domain_taken, domain_reserved, invalid_domain, access_locked, network_unavailable, network_conflict.

apps_port.description: Port of the application listener; present only when it is enabled. Open an application at http://<domain>.localhost:<apps_port>, never by 127.0.0.1 and a port, which would send the owner cookie.

value.description: Value to store. Secret values are never returned.

project_id.description: Owning project, or null when unassigned.

version.description: Precondition token for edits; unchanged by moving between projects.

service_used.description: Permanent mark: a runtime service was once requested, so the application cannot be deleted nor change image. Written before dispatch, in any mode.

access.description: Network access. isolated (default): no network. internal: bridge network shared with the project's applications, nothing published. local: internal plus a loopback port reachable at http://<domain>.localhost:<apps_port>.

shared_network.description: Also join the common network. Not allowed when isolated.

domain.description: Lowercase DNS label (2-40 characters, a-z, 0-9 and hyphen, starting with a letter) under .localhost. Only for local access, unique across applications, never reassigned.

access.description: Network access. isolated (default): no network. internal: bridge network shared with the project's applications, nothing published. local: internal plus a loopback port reachable at http://<domain>.localhost:<apps_port>.

shared_network.description: Also join the common network. Not allowed when isolated.

domain.description: Only for local access; defaults to the application name when omitted or empty. If that name is not a valid domain the request fails with invalid_domain.

exit_code.description: Exit status of a stopped container; only present in the response to an inspection (refresh), not persisted.

access.description: Access the service was requested with.

domain.description: Name under .localhost for local access, otherwise null. The host port is never exposed; the interface composes the URL from this and capabilities.apps_port.

application_ids.description: Former members, now unassigned; use to undo.

access.description: Network access. isolated (default): no network. internal: bridge network shared with the project's applications, nothing published. local: internal plus a loopback port reachable at http://<domain>.localhost:<apps_port>.

shared_network.description: Also join the common network. Not allowed when isolated.

domain.description: Only for local access. Omit access, shared_network and domain to keep them; otherwise omitted fields keep their stored value, leaving local clears the domain and entering local without one defaults it to the name.

allOf.description: Application plus configuration and service summary, computed with a fixed number of queries. The last change is max(updated_at, config.updated_at); the service has no dates.

config.description: Current encrypted configuration revision; never values. Null without configuration or when unavailable.

updated_at.description: Null for revisions written before dates were recorded.

config_unavailable.description: The configuration store could not be read.

service.description: Experimental service state; null without the experimental runtime or without a service, or when unavailable.

service_unavailable.description: Experimental runtime enabled but this application's service state could not be read (store failure or an invalid intention row). Per item, so a bare array response is kept.

created_at.description: Null when the revision predates date recording.

base.description: Oldest retained revision: its changes list every variable as added.

from_revision.description: Retained revision to read the variable from.

reference.description: Canonical registry/name[:tag]@sha256:digest form to save; the tag is kept for display and the digest decides what runs.

resolved_from.description: name:tag resolved to the digest through the public registry (experimental mode only).

status.description: not_checked without the experimental runtime; unknown if the daemon could not be asked.

reason.description: For incompatible: platform or volumes. For pull_failed: platform, not_found, timeout or unavailable.

exposed_port.description: Lowest TCP port the image declares with EXPOSE; absent if none or unknown. Use it to suggest local access and the port.
